description: Land  Acquisition - Etthiligoda South & Milidduwa Four Gravets D/S Division, Galle District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains a declaration by the Minister for the acquisition of specific land parcels for public purpose, including detailed descriptions of 19 land allotments with their boundaries, extents, and claimant information. The content focuses solely on land/property matters without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or any other specialized category.
